## Description

Add plan-trace (or sibling) assertions that lock execute-phase original-text brief wording (R5) and extend criterion_optional_in_contract to assert brief/plan/verification acceptance roles omit criterion (R4).

## Approach

1. In tests/test_plan_trace.py (or a focused neighbor), assert skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md requires quoting Description/Approach and requirement texts by id and forbids paraphrasing / criterion-as-claim.
2. Extend test_criterion_optional_in_contract to assert brief/plan/verification acceptance requires_payload exclude criterion.
3. Keep skill_contract_consistency green. Do not change skills/contract unless a tiny wording tweak is required for extractable assertions.
4. Commit on phase/atomic-claims excluding .artifacts.

payload.title: Lock original-text briefs and R4 view asserts in plan-trace
